title: Why Is MS Dhoni Hated? 5 Real Reasons Some Fans Criticise Him
seoTitle: Why Is Dhoni Hated? 5 Real Reasons Fans Criticise Him
seoDescription: Why do some fans hate MS Dhoni? Favouritism claims, captaincy calls, slow late-career batting, his 2020 retirement and his long IPL stay, explained.
excerpt: Why MS Dhoni draws criticism despite his record, from claims of favouring CSK players and debated captaincy calls to his slower batting late in his career, his retirement timing and his focus on the IPL.
